sources.title: StepAudio 3 ASR - StepFun Documentation
sources.snippet: The StepAudio 3 ASR family provides high-accuracy, low-latency speech transcription. StepAudio 3 ASR Max is StepFun's largest ASR model to date. Built on a large language model, it fuses high-precision acoustic modeling with that model's context understanding, knowledge, and reasoning—moving speech recognition from recognizing sound toward understanding context.
